# Search the file system for driving license related files
# We'll use substring filters to narrow down, recursively.

fs_token = file_system_token

candidates = []
for substr in ['driving', 'license', 'licence', 'id', 'driver']:
    page_index = 0
    # show_directory doesn't have pagination; it returns all matching in that call.
    res = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='/', substring=substr, entry_type='all', recursive=True)
    print('substring', substr, 'result:', res)
    candidates.append((substr, res))

print('done_search')

gmail_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail')
gmail_username = 'cod.smith@gmail.com'
gmail_res = apis.gmail.login(username=gmail_username, password=gmail_pw)
print(gmail_res)
gmail_token = gmail_res['access_token']

import os

driving_license_path = '/home/cody/documents/personal/identity/driving_license.pdf'
partner_email = partner_contacts[0]['email']
partner_name = partner_contacts[0]['first_name'] + ' ' + partner_contacts[0]['last_name']
file_name = os.path.basename(driving_license_path)

# Verify file exists (single read/check)
print('file_exists', apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=file_system_token, file_path=driving_license_path))

subject = 'Driving license'
body = f'Hi {partner_name},\n\nAttached is the driving license I found in my files.\n\nThanks,'

send_res = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[partner_email],
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[driving_license_path],
    file_system_access_token=file_system_token
)
print('send_res', send_res)

sent_email_id = send_res['sent_email_id']
shown = apis.gmail.show_email(email_id=sent_email_id, access_token=gmail_token)
print('shown_subject', shown['subject'])
print('shown_attachments', [a['file_name'] for a in shown.get('attachments', [])])
print('attachment_match', file_name in [a['file_name'] for a in shown.get('attachments', [])])
